title: 10 Dscout alternatives for qualitative research teams
summary: Compare 10 Dscout alternatives on diary features, panels, and pricing, plus when to stick with Dscout.
body_markdown:
Does Dscout publish its pricing? +


No. As of November 2026, Dscout lists three paid plans on its pricing page, Core, Select, and Enterprise, but doesn’t show a price for any of them or list a free plan. Each plan is set up as a custom quote, so you’ll need to talk to sales to get a number. Studies also use activity credits that come with your subscription, which means the final cost depends on how many studies you run and how many participants take part in each one.


What’s the closest alternative to Dscout for diary studies? +


Indeemo is the closest like-for-like swap. It’s a mobile ethnography app where participants record video entries and photos on their phone as things happen, with push reminders that keep diary entries coming in. You can recruit participants through its panel partner or invite your own users with a link or QR code. If you’d rather run each diary entry as a conversation, Conveo’s AI research assistant follows up on each person’s earlier entries, so you capture the reason behind a behavior as well as the moment itself.


How do AI-moderated diary studies handle follow-up questions and traceability? +


In an AI-moderated diary study, each entry becomes a short conversation. The AI interviewer asks a follow-up question when an answer is vague or leaves a gap, much as a human moderator would in a live interview, so you get the reason behind the behavior while it’s still fresh. For traceability, check that every theme and summary links back to the participant and the exact moment in the video it came from. That way you can check the context yourself before a finding goes into a report.


How does diary study software keep participants engaged? +


Diary platforms keep participants engaged by making each entry quick and easy to remember. Automated reminders prompt people at the time of day the behavior usually happens, and short tasks on a phone take a few minutes to finish. Splitting a longitudinal diary study into activities with their own deadlines helps too, because participants always know what’s due next. Paying incentives after each completed activity also gives people a reason to keep going through to the final entry.


Can teams run Dscout and another research platform together? +


Yes. One setup keeps Dscout for mobile diary studies and unmoderated usability testing and adds a separate tool for other work, such as AI-moderated interviews or a research repository that stores findings across studies. Running separate tools means paying for two contracts and keeping research data in two places, so agree on shared tags and theme names from the start. That way, findings from both tools can be compared side by side, and switching tools later doesn’t mean redoing your analysis.


Which security and compliance credentials should a diary study platform have? +


Diary data often includes video of people at home, so look for enterprise-grade security. At a minimum, that means SOC 2 Type II certification and GDPR compliance. If you run research in Europe, check where the platform hosts its data, since some store everything in the US. Teams in healthcare should also ask about HIPAA. It’s worth requesting the vendor’s subprocessor list, which shows every other company that handles your data.
